# Quake 2 Rerelease Map Trainer

A training mod for Quake 2 Rerelease — item path training, item timing, jump/bhop practice, speedometer, and spawn trainer.

## Installation

1. Copy this `maptrain` folder into your Quake 2 `baseq2` directory:
   ```
   <Steam>\steamapps\common\Quake 2\rerelease\baseq2\maptrain\
   ```
2. Launch Quake 2 Rerelease
3. In the console (`~`), run:
   ```
   game maptrain
   ```
4. Load a deathmatch map (e.g. `map q2dm1`)

## Quick usage

- Open the trainer menu: `maptrainer`
- Save/load jump position: `savepos` / `loadpos` (also available in the Jump Trainer submenu)

Full documentation: https://github.com/ozy24/q2re-map-trainer
